note: Hebrew 'anush means "incurable, mortally ill" (cf. 15:18, 17:16 "day of sickness", 30:12); the verse describes the heart as hopelessly diseased rather than "wicked", a frequently quoted text.

kjv: the partridge sitteth [on eggs], and hatcheth [them] not
mine: the partridge that gathers a brood that she did not hatch
note: Hebrew qore' dagar welo' yalad is "a partridge that broods (gathers) what it did not lay", reflecting the belief that it steals others' eggs; the KJV makes it fail to hatch its own.
